title: Decision Models as Scalable Economic Surrogates that Capture Human Variation
abstract: arXiv:2611.05553v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decision Models (DMs), a new class of AI models, give fast responses and return a probability distribution over a fixed set of options. These properties make them candidate human surrogates in economic simulations and surveys, a role increasingly filled by Large Language Models (LLMs), which are costly at scale and under-represent the variation in human behaviour. We present a first evaluation of DMs as human surrogates in economics, comparing 10 DMs with 8 LLMs in three economic settings: a household spending survey on consumption, several classic economic games and a labour-market field experiment. Frontier DMs, those that score highest on general decision-making benchmarks, reproduce the variation in human responses more closely than LLMs in all three settings. translated_title: 决策模型：能够捕捉人类差异的可扩展经济替代模型
translated_abstract: 决策模型（DMs）是一类新型AI模型，能够快速给出响应，并返回一组固定选项上的概率分布。这些特性使其成为经济模拟与调查中人类替代者的有力候选——这一角色目前正越来越多地由大语言模型（LLMs）承担，但LLMs在大规模应用时成本高昂，且无法充分体现人类行为的多样性。我们首次评估了DMs在经济学领域作为人类替代者的表现，在三种经济场景中将10个DMs与8个LLMs进行比较：一项关于消费的家庭支出调查、若干经典经济博弈，以及一项劳动力市场田野实验。在所有三种场景中，前沿DMs（即在通用决策基准上得分最高的模型）都比LLMs更贴近地再现了人类回应的多样性。在支出调查中，它们对人类最典型回应的捕捉能力与LLMs相当，但在经济博弈中表现稍逊。此外，前沿DMs的速度比最快的……大约快十倍
tldr: 本研究首次评估了决策模型在经济学中作为人类替代者的潜力，发现前沿决策模型在三种经济场景中比大语言模型更能再现人类回应的多样性，同时速度快约十倍，是大规模经济模拟与调查的更优选择。
en_tdlr: In the first evaluation of Decision Models as human surrogates in economics, frontier DMs reproduce human response variation more faithfully than LLMs across three economic settings while being roughly ten times faster, making them a scalable alternative for economic simulations and surveys.
